category_title: Students with SCD engaged in passive, non-academic tasks like stuffing envelopes
scenario_title: Non-academic tasks in a highly distracting environment
minimal_context: The student is sitting at a desk in a self-contained classroom with the goal of stuffing a pile of envelopes.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the pile of papers and the envelopes. Please start stuffing the envelopes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly at the desk, looking at the envelopes without touching them as a peer across the room begins making loud, repetitive moaning noises.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and put the papers in.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Picks up one paper but stops, turning their head to passively watch the other activities and instructional routines happening in the classroom.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep working on those. Anyway, as I was saying to the other teacher, the schedule for tomorrow is completely changed...

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Drops the paper back onto the desk and sits completely still, demonstrating no competing behavior but remaining entirely disengaged from the task as the adults continue their off-task conversation.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is the pile of papers and the envelopes. Please start stuffing the envelopes.

STUDENT: (Sits quietly at the desk, looking at the envelopes without touching them as a peer across the room begins making loud, repetitive moaning noises.)

TUTOR: Go ahead and put the papers in.

STUDENT: (Picks up one paper but stops, turning their head to passively watch the other activities and instructional routines happening in the classroom.)

TUTOR: Keep working on those. Anyway, as I was saying to the other teacher, the schedule for tomorrow is completely changed...

STUDENT: (Drops the paper back onto the desk and sits completely still, demonstrating no competing behavior but remaining entirely disengaged from the task as the adults continue their off-task conversation.)

task.content: engaged in a non-grade aligned task, such as stuffing envelopes or completing a puzzle

context.environment: self-contained high school special education classrooms

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Adults often appeared off-task in their conversations with one another
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: demonstrated no competing behavior (defined as aggression, disruption, self-stimulatory behaviors, asleep, or non-compliance; 70%)

behavior_patterns.condition: surrounded by environmental distractions such as staff talking to one another (34%) and other peers making loud noises (i.e., repetitive moaning or oral reciting behaviors; 15%)
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: frequently passive observers of activities and instructional routines
